verdict.rationale: Munito AI is an open-model inference API provider. Event-driven automation rules are a plausible platform feature for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoints, document extraction, transcription, and model capabilities such as tool calls. Tool calls are a developer building block, not a user-definable rule engine, and nothing documents defining rules that trigger actions on events.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
